name: Yeh Shih
bio: Yeh Shih was a Sung scholar and poet. His poem here is a garden gate shut against the spring.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: At a Park Gate
poems.author: Yeh Shih
poems.text:
'Tis closed! — lest trampling footsteps mar the glory of the green.
Time after time we knock and knock; no janitor is seen.
Yet bolts and bars can't quite shut in the spring-time's beauteous pall:
A pink-flowered almond-spray peeps out athwart the envious wall!
